reason: All five confirmed suffix-reaching regex findings are implemented and validated at bbe2acd. Accepted finite endpoints now separate sanitized captures from their continuation frontier, reference repeats test downstream constraints lazily, and direct REG_NOSUB matching tries the suffix-aligned candidate first. Focused, recorder-libc, isolated resource, fresh MSGTYPE, broad non-mutation, generated/static, and development checks pass.

boundary.startingEvent: A valid ASCII POSIX ERE installed by startup MSGTYPE or AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION is matched through the recorder-glibc REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB contract.
boundary.endingEvent: Matching selects the same boolean and MSGTYPE action as recorder glibc within the committed direct and reference time/memory budgets at exact 255-byte pattern and message limits.
boundary.validInputs: Finite repeated groups with referenced descendants, suffix-reaching correlated and zero-minimum reference patterns, and unanchored direct/reference wide-frontier patterns within the source byte limits.
boundary.observables: Match boolean and installed MSGTYPE action, complete fresh screens/cursors and PRNG calls, plus isolated wall time and maxRSS for every declared exact-boundary resource case.
boundary.exclusions: Non-ASCII C.UTF-8 locale matching, runtime autopickup object filtering, interactive MSGTYPE editing/serialization, USER_SOUNDS, and behavior after the next message/input boundary remain named before-effect boundaries.

candidateListMethod.upstreamEntryPoints: sys/share/posixregex.c regex_match delegates to glibc regexec; glibc capture endpoint selection defines the finite-repeat result; options.c msgtype_type and add_autopickup_exception are the installed consumers.
candidateListMethod.dispatchTablesAndCatalogs: The shared exact-boundary fixture catalog, its complete budget map, 255-byte source limits, repeat endpoint states, referenced capture ids, candidate starts, and absolute suffix constraints define the audited families.
candidateListMethod.reachableHelpers: The audit supplied direct-libc/live MSGTYPE discriminators for the endpoint defect and four suffix-reaching exact-boundary families that separately exercise correlated state, zero-minimum state, direct candidate ordering, and reference candidate reuse.
candidateListMethod.javascriptCrossCheck: Inspect js/posixregex.js repeat endpoint/continuation projections, direct/reference sequence search and suffix feasibility, plus all shared fixture/oracle/resource consumers for masked paths, separate catalogs, aborts, or guessed booleans.
candidateListMethod.remainingLimits: The five confirmed deferrals are closed without a state-count abort or guessed boolean. The catalog names literal-suffix guard coverage separately from suffix-reaching direct memo, reference memo, zero-minimum, and correlated-frontier cases.

entries.reachability: A bounded repeated group first captures a referenced descendant and may either stop at an intermediate count or continue through a nonparticipating sibling to its maximum.
entries.effects: The accepted endpoint must clear descendant captures while the continuation frontier retains them, or MSGTYPE selects the wrong action.
entries.evidence: Recorder libc rejects ^((a)|b){0,2}\2$ on aa and accepts aba; the corrected evaluator and installed live MSGTYPE rule now select those same actions.
entries.remaining: None; focused, libc-oracle, and two fresh startup segments pin the sanitized aa endpoint and retained aba continuation.

entries.reachability: A valid 255-byte suffix-reaching reference pattern materializes large repeat/capture frontiers before downstream references and fixed suffix structure decide viability.
entries.effects: Synchronous matching exceeds the committed 2,000 ms and 128 MiB budget while producing the correct boolean.
entries.evidence: A correlated near-miss reached about 177 MiB, and a zero-minimum valid match reached about 4.4 seconds/943 MiB; recorder libc agreed on both booleans within the budget.
entries.remaining: None; lazy continuation testing and incremental frontier deduplication preserve exact booleans. The zero-minimum valid match measured 152 ms/107 MiB and the correlated near-miss 859 ms/122 MiB under their 2,000 ms/128 MiB budgets.

entries.effects: Left-to-right candidate work exceeds the committed 1,000 ms budget despite REG_NOSUB exposing only a boolean.
entries.evidence: The 255-byte wide-frontier pattern on a 255-byte suffix-reaching input matched like libc but independently measured about 1.2 seconds, over budget.
entries.remaining: None; REG_NOSUB tries the suffix-aligned rightmost candidate first while every evaluator call retains its actual matchStart. The exact case measured 2.5 ms/49 MiB under its 1,000 ms/96 MiB budget.
